tasks.short: Direct research department operations and coordinate projects

steps.what: Read actual research project progress, resource constraints and cross-department dependencies
inputs: existing actual project updates and dependency records
current resource availability
outputs: verified current project status and unresolved gaps

steps.what: Set daily department priorities and decide how to handle research project constraints
inputs: verified current project status and unresolved gaps
current research commitments

steps.what: Coordinate actual project activities, ownership and dependencies with other departments
inputs: proposed priorities and coordination decisions
other departments' actual constraints and responses
outputs: agreed activities, owners and dependency conditions

steps.what: Record the actual agreed activities, owners, dates and unresolved dependencies
inputs: agreed activities, owners and dependency conditions

steps.what: Prepare the coordination message from the recorded agreement and colleague recipients
inputs: complete agreed activity update draft
existing verified colleague contacts

steps.what: Approve the completed activity update and exact coordination message and recipients
inputs: complete agreed activity update draft
complete coordination message and recipients
outputs: approved final activity update and coordination message/recipients

steps.what: Send the approved coordination message to the specified internal colleagues
inputs: approved final activity update and coordination message/recipients

steps.what: Commit the approved activity update in the same project system
inputs: approved final activity update and coordination message/recipients

tasks.design: Configure native {PROJECT} status views and an {EMAIL} coordination template. The scientist decides priorities, agrees actual work with departments and captures that agreement before approving the finished update and message for separate commit and send.
tasks.previous_blocker: A project plan does not establish actual progress or another department's agreement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native status views and templates can reduce gathering and repeated message assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Balance uncertain research work and conflicting departmental commitments.
tasks.human_edge: Make trade-offs and build a workable agreement.

ambition.what: Support existing department operations without automating work allocation decisions.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; verify project access and staff-data consultation requirements

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: project systems can show existing status fields and recorded agreements can populate coordination message templates.

assumptions: Existing project owners supply actual status, completed milestone/date, dependency, resource availability and issue reference. s1 reads originals and includes manual missing-update follow-up. No planned completion is treated as actual and no new staff status capture is assumed free.

s3 obtains actual colleague agreement; s4 counts entering activity, owner, date and unresolved dependency. Native views and message templates come first. Central retains 60% of gathering and 50% of message preparation and removes only a real distinct internal send; priority judgement and coordination remain full time.

s6 follows both finished artefacts and approves exact versions and recipients. Changed content invalidates the relevant approval. s7 and s8 are distinct actions with distinct approval references. Same-system s8 commit is approximately zero time and earns no saving. Colleagues' participation remains unchanged outside focal labour.
Provisional B=100, R=87, gross=13; incremental focal view/template upkeep=1; net=12. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Current status-view coverage and actual repeated message assembly.
research_questions: Observe a daily coordination cycle and separate actual agreement capture from status gathering and message preparation.

already_counted.description: Final activity/message version review retained at s6

approvals.approved_version: complete final coordination message and exact internal recipients

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero with existing native status and message coverage; high allows four extra hours gathering missing actual updates beyond central net 12.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in staffing and direct subordinate training

steps.what: Review actual research staffing needs, skill gaps and current commitments
inputs: existing staffing roster and actual project commitments
actual observed skill needs

steps.what: Participate with authorised managers in staffing decisions for the research department
inputs: confirmed staffing requirements and constraints
authorised managers' actual discussion and decisions
outputs: agreed staffing input and unresolved staffing questions

steps.what: Record and confirm the scientist's actual staffing input and agreed follow-up
inputs: agreed staffing input and unresolved staffing questions

steps.what: Save the confirmed staffing note in the same restricted document store
inputs: confirmed final departmental staffing note

steps.what: Determine subordinate training objectives from actual work and observed skill needs
inputs: actual observed skill needs and current research methods
existing approved technical learning sources
outputs: confirmed training objectives and source material

steps.what: Prepare the technical training plan and practice material for the confirmed objectives
inputs: confirmed training objectives and source material
outputs: complete proposed training plan and practice material

loop.purpose: Draft source-grounded technical training explanations and exercises
loop.input: scientist-selected objectives and approved method/source material
loop.output: proposed plan and exercises with source references
loop.check: Scientist checks technical correctness, intended skill coverage, exercise answers and omissions; no model rates employees or selects staffing outcomes
loop.stop: One draft and one correction, then manual preparation
loop.why_not_simpler: Existing lessons and templates come first; explaining research methods for a specific learning objective needs semantic wording

steps.what: Review the completed training material and confirm it is fit for instruction
inputs: complete proposed training plan and practice material
confirmed training objectives and source material

steps.what: Direct training, coach subordinate practice and check actual understanding
inputs: reviewed final training material
subordinates' actual questions and practice
outputs: actual training participation, observed learning and follow-up needs

steps.what: Record and confirm actual training participation, observed results and agreed follow-up
inputs: actual training participation, observed learning and follow-up needs

steps.what: Save the confirmed actual training record in the same learning system
inputs: confirmed final actual training record

tasks.design: Retain staffing participation and actual decision notes in {HCM}, {PROJECT} and restricted {DOCS} context. Assist technical training wording from scientist-selected sources, then keep live coaching and post-training actual results in {LMS} with the scientist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Project needs and a planned training event do not establish staffing suitability or actual learning.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded source-grounded drafting can support training material preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Participate in staffing trade-offs and coach research skills from actual practice.
tasks.human_edge: Understand people and the uncertainty of research work.

ambition.what: Support training preparation without automating staffing or employee assessments.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; verify restricted staffing/source access and staff consultation requirements

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: models can propose source-grounded technical learning material for expert review while staffing and coaching remain human decisions.

assumptions: Existing roster/project records supply actual staffing and commitments; scientist supplies actual observed skill needs in s1/s5. Authorised managers make staffing decisions with the scientist's participation; their independent work is unchanged outside focal labour. s3 explicitly captures the scientist's actual input and follow-up, not a new hiring or termination action.

s5 counts selecting and recording training objectives and source references. Existing technical owners supply approved method/procedure content; missing source steps or answers require manual preparation. Model input contains objectives and approved technical content, not employee profiles or staffing assessments.

Native lessons and templates come first. Central retains 60% of material preparation and all s7 final technical review. Live coaching and actual outcome entry remain unchanged. s9 uses actual s8 participation and observations; planned attendance never becomes completion.

The completed staffing note is confirmed before s4 save and the completed actual training record before s10 save. Edits void approvals. Both same-system saves are approximately zero time and earn no saving; they are distinct actions. Provisional B=100, R=94, gross=6; incremental focal source/material upkeep=1; net=5. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Current reusable lesson coverage and actual technical correction burden.
research_questions: Compare material preparation including exercise validation while keeping staffing decisions, live coaching and actual outcome capture separate.

already_counted.description: Final technical training-material review retained at s7

incremental.description: Maintain approved technical learning sources and inspect exercise failures

approvals.approved_version: complete confirmed restricted departmental staffing note
complete confirmed record of actual training participation and results

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where existing lessons already cover preparation; high allows two extra hours correcting technical exercises beyond central net 5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare, monitor and approve research operating budgets

steps.what: Retrieve actual research operating costs, commitments and the current approved budget
inputs: existing posted personnel, computing, equipment and service costs
open commitments and current approved department budget

steps.what: Reconcile actual research costs and commitment coverage against department budget codes
inputs: source-linked actual-cost and commitment extract
existing approved budget code definitions
outputs: validated actual costs, commitments and unresolved anomalies

steps.what: Estimate and record operational resource quantities and timing for planned research work
inputs: actual research progress and remaining commitments
existing finance-approved cost rates and supplier terms
outputs: scientist-confirmed resource quantities, timing and rate references

steps.what: Prepare the proposed operating budget using validated costs and resource estimates
inputs: validated actual costs, commitments and unresolved anomalies
scientist-confirmed resource quantities, timing and rate references
outputs: complete proposed operating budget with calculation references

steps.what: Monitor actual expenditure variances against the existing approved operating budget
inputs: validated actual costs, commitments and unresolved anomalies
existing approved operating budget
outputs: checked actual budget variances and emerging constraints

steps.what: Decide budget adjustments and enter the final proposed allocation and assumptions
inputs: complete proposed operating budget with calculation references
checked actual budget variances and emerging constraints
outputs: complete adjusted operating budget and assumptions

steps.what: Approve the exact final operating budget and adjustments within existing delegated authority
inputs: complete adjusted operating budget and assumptions
existing delegated budget authority

steps.what: Commit the approved operating budget version in the same budget system
inputs: approved final operating budget version

tasks.design: Configure native {ERP} cost views and fixed budget calculations using scientist-entered {PROJECT} resource quantities. Use {BI} variance comparisons to support monitoring; the scientist decides adjustments and approves the finished budget before its separate commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual expenditure cannot supply future research resource requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and fixed quantity/rate calculations can support preparation and comparison.
tasks.still_hard: Allocate resources under uncertain research progress and funding constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Judge which research commitments and capacity needs justify a budget change.

ambition.what: Support existing budget responsibilities without expanding delegated authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4; verify financial access, approval authority and consultation needs

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: financial systems can combine actual costs with entered resource quantities and rates and display fixed budget variances.

assumptions: Finance/procurement owners supply actual cost amount/currency/date/budget code and open commitment coverage in existing records. s1 retrieves and s2 reconciles these sources. Computing runtime is a cost input, not human labour saved. Missing or disputed costs remain manual.

s3 counts producing and entering resource category, quantity/unit, period and rate reference from actual research progress and remaining scope. Existing finance owners supply approved rates, unit/currency conversions and budget rules. Missing quantities or rates stop calculation; no model guesses requirements.

Native budget configuration comes first. Central retains 60% of gathering, 50% of preparation arithmetic and 70% of variance handling; only fixed comparisons shrink in s5, while reading and interpreting exceptions remain. Existing native reports and calculations already running earn no additional saving.

s5 monitors the existing approved budget, not the unapproved s4 proposal. s6 produces the complete adjusted version before s7 approval and s8 commit. Scenario assumes existing delegated authority; required higher approval remains unchanged and must be priced before deployment. Edits invalidate approval; same-system commit is approximately zero time and earns no saving.
Provisional B=100, R=79, gross=21; incremental focal mapping/rule upkeep=2; net=19. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Existing budget-view coverage and delegated approval limits.
research_questions: Reproduce an operating-budget cycle, checking actual cost coverage and scientist-produced future resource quantities.

already_counted.description: Final budget version approval retained in s7

incremental.description: Review budget mappings, rates and fixed calculation rules

approvals.approved_version: complete final adjusted operating budget and assumptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where native budgeting already covers the work; high allows six extra hours resolving research cost and resource-rate exceptions beyond central net 19.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Research scientists retain department, staffing, learning and budget decisions; native views, fixed arithmetic and reviewed material drafts support selected administration.
reach: Finance analyst: learn cost and commitment coverage
Learning coordinator: learn actual training-result capture
skills_to_grow: Trace budget quantities and rates to producers
role.ambitious_version: A research leader coordinates real commitments, develops colleagues and maintains checked budgets while keeping scientific and personnel judgement human.
